0.content: Lantern Coast is a harbour town built on stacked docks and crooked stairs, lit at night by thousands of charmed lanterns. Dockhands, the Lantern Guard, smugglers and old free companies share its alleys, and most quarrels are settled with a blade, a charm or both. Fights here are scraps, not wars: nobody dies in a duel unless they are very unlucky. Blades are physical, charms are spirit; skills run Novice, Trained, Adept, Expert, Master. This lorebook belongs to the sample world "Lantern Coast Skirmishes".
